description: EVA Air Infinity MileageLands Award Miles, Status Miles and qualifying flight sectors for EVA Air flights. Award Miles and Status Miles = distance x booking-class % (C 175; J 150; D, K 125; L, T 115; P, Y, B 100; M, H, Q 75; S, W, V 50; A and group tickets G 0), plus a tier bonus on Award Miles only on international flights (Silver 15%, Gold and Diamond 25%). Progress toward the next card by Status Miles or flights; sm and fl are the Status Miles and qualifying flights so far. Give segs: one entry per one-way flight, in order, with its great-circle miles (calculate_flight_distance gives them) and the ISO country codes of its two airports. Takes no price. Uses cwsi.net's calculator and the airline's published rules. Unofficial.

cls.description: Booking class. C = C (Business Up, 175%); J = J (Business Standard, 150%); D = D (Business Basic, 125%); K = K (Premium Economy Up, 125%); LT = L, T (Premium Economy Standard, 115%); P = P (Premium Economy Basic, 100%); YB = Y, B (Economy Up, 100%); MHQ = M, H, Q (Economy Standard, 75%); SWV = S, W, V (Economy Basic, 50%); A = A (Economy Discount, 0%); G = G (Group tickets, 0%). The letter on your ticket. The percentage is of the distance flown.

creditClass.description: The booking class letter for creditTo, when it differs from the class question. Ignored without creditTo.

creditFlights.description: The flights for creditTo: one entry per one-way flight, in order, with its great-circle miles (calculate_flight_distance gives them) and optionally from/to airport codes. Defaults to segs when they carry miles.

from.description: The departure airport's code; labels the breakdown.

miles.description: Great-circle distance of this flight in miles.

to.description: The arrival airport's code; labels the breakdown.

creditStatus.description: Your status in the creditTo program, by its name as listed under creditTo. Defaults to the base level. Ignored without creditTo.

creditTo.description: Credit the flights to a partner program instead of EVA Air's own: united = United MileagePlus (creditStatus one of: General member, Premier Silver, Premier Gold, Premier Platinum, Premier 1K); aeroplan = Aeroplan (creditStatus one of: Aeroplan Member, 25K, 35K, 50K, 75K, Super Elite). Earns by each flight's distance and the booking class at the program's published partner rates; leave creditTo out for the airline's own program. The booking class is cls (or creditClass). The flights are segs (their miles), or creditFlights.

fl.description: Qualifying flights so far (optional). EVA Air and UNI Air international flights (whole flights). Used only for the progress.

segs.description: The flights, one way and in order, one entry per flight (1 to 8): fromCountry and toCountry, the ISO 3166 two-letter country codes of its two airports; miles, its great-circle distance in miles (1 to 12,500); optional from and to, the IATA codes of its two airports, which label the breakdown; some airlines also use them (Vladivostok, VVO, on JAL and ANA; the Madrid-Barcelona Air Shuttle, MAD-BCN, on Iberia; the long-haul tables named by city on SAS).

from.description: The departure airport's IATA code, e.g. SYD. Labels the breakdown; JAL and ANA use it to spot Vladivostok (VVO), Qantas to pick its route tables, Iberia to spot the Madrid-Barcelona Air Shuttle (MAD, BCN), and SAS to pick its long-haul tables (named by city).

fromCountry.description: ISO 3166 two-letter country code of the departure airport, e.g. DE.

miles.description: Great-circle distance of this flight in miles.

to.description: The arrival airport's IATA code, e.g. SYD. Labels the breakdown; JAL and ANA use it to spot Vladivostok (VVO), Qantas to pick its route tables, Iberia to spot the Madrid-Barcelona Air Shuttle (MAD, BCN), and SAS to pick its long-haul tables (named by city).

toCountry.description: ISO 3166 two-letter country code of the arrival airport, e.g. DE.

sm.description: Status Miles you have so far (optional). Counted in the 12 months during your current tier. Used only for the progress.

status.description: Your Infinity MileageLands card. GR = Green Card; SI = Silver Card (+15% Award Miles); GO = Gold Card (+25% Award Miles); DI = Diamond Card (+25% Award Miles).

trip.description: Trip. ow = One way; rt = Round trip. Round trip counts the same flights back the other way.
